scope: Actual first-book UI, bundled SDK and isolated IndexedDB, with anonymous Auth HTTP and local fault/delay injection. Chromium viewports only; no real Google, production writes, Apple hardware or native IME.

checks.name: record selection enables reflection intake and a failed write consumes selection only after successful retry
a reload banner from before editing cannot discard a newly created book after a CAS conflict; explicit comparison retries the same book
a delayed successful book creation cannot navigate or expose the book after an account switch
